# proxmox_node_service (Resource)

Manages the run state of one system service through `/nodes/{node}/services/{service}/{start|stop}`. Destroy leaves the service running. Changing `triggers` re-applies the state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_service" "spice" {
  node    = "pve-1"
  service = "spiceproxy"
  state   = "running"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node. Changes require replacement.
- `service` (String) Service name such as `pveproxy`. Changes require replacement.
- `state` (String) Desired state: `running` or `stopped`.

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Optional values that force a re-apply when changed, for example to restart a service.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<service>` form.
